input.label: Direct answer
input.text: Direct answer: according to the only material, if implementation A stops after gateway.send returns but before mark_sent runs, and then restarts, the reminder is sent again. The supplied report records two visible messages in total, with the sent marker present afterwards, so the recipient sees a duplicate. This is a single scenario for reminder R8 in an illustrative, invented report in which no tests were run. I found no supplied evidence for the case where the worker dies during the gateway call itself, or for implementation B. So the answer is a duplicate on restart, supported only by an untested fixture.

citations.quote: Fresh R8: stop the worker after gateway.send returns and before mark_sent starts.
Restart the worker with R8: two visible messages total; sent marker present.
No tests ran to produce it.
